critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/app/ProMappingEditor.jsx is 725 lines — within tolerance but approaching the 700 split guideline. Natural split candidates: (a) overlay renderers (ElementOverlay, DraftOverlay, ElementLabel, labelPosition) into a sibling ProMappingOverlays.jsx, (b) right-pane renderers (SchemaPane / FormPane / PreviewPane / elementsToFieldMap / buildFakeSession) into ProMappingPanes.jsx. Each are self-contained and would bring the main editor under ~350 lines.

ProMappingEditor.handleFinish persists via saveTemplate + setActiveTemplateId but does NOT verify whether the underlying IndexedDB write resolves (no assertion) — current code awaits both calls so a thrown error surfaces via the catch, but if localforage silently fails to persist (e.g. storage quota), the user still sees 'Template saved' then a broken dashboard preview. Consider a readback after save to confirm persistence on mobile Safari (known storage-pressure behavior).

ProMappingEditor.commitElement always pushes even if geometry is degenerate (e.g. a circle with r==0.02 default from a tap without drag-move). Currently harmless because the point tool is the no-drag entry, but if the user picks circle and just taps (no pointermove), a visible 0.02r circle is committed on pointerup. That's not a bug per spec (pointerUp guards r > 0.015) — but worth flagging because tap+up (no move) IS enough to pass the threshold (0.02 > 0.015) and commits a default circle. Consider ignoring circle commits where pointermove never fired.

TemplateSetup.jsx handleContinueToMap creates a new emptyTemplate BEFORE the driver finishes mapping — if the driver cancels the Pro editor with pro-mapping-cancel, the half-empty template is already persisted in IndexedDB (name='Scan N', schema.elements=[]). StoredTemplates will render a zero-field orphan. Consider deferring saveTemplate until handleMapDone, OR auto-cleaning templates with schema.elements=[] on re-entry.

DynamicPaperSheet consumes template.fields synthesized from elementsToFieldMap (ProMappingEditor.jsx L700-725) — only the 16 hardcoded label keys (date/driver/truck/order/bol/pickup/drop/city/state/time/trailer/notes) map. Any other Pro-Mapping label (e.g. 'Driver Info Box') silently disappears from the preview. Not a bug, but expect driver complaints the first time they label something not in the preset map; consider graceful fallback (e.g. render the unmapped label as placeholder text at the anchor).
